model_scope: Historical separate observation/dynamics-context models; none has the current spatial T/g/M decoder.
metric: MSE at fifth recursive prediction in immutable canonical 192-dimensional frozen reference coordinates, verified identical across compared checkpoints within each task.
comparator: Framewise calibration within the same task, predictor family, training seed and evaluated windows.
gain_definition: 100*(1 - mean_of_three_ours_seed_MSEs / mean_of_three_control_seed_MSEs); positive lower error, negative regression. Not mean of per-seed gains.
limits: Forecast error is not planning success or causal evidence for context inference.
No T/g/M is available for historical models; missing modules must not be displayed as zeros.
Simulation source photos are task input illustrations, not the evaluated population or forecast RGB.
DROID/IWS feature spaces, populations, inputs and horizons differ; no cross-family accuracy ranking.
IWS training-input snapshot remains PushT seeds0/1, Box0/1/2, Rope0/2.
